name: Gasthof Mühle
beschreibung: The Gasthof Mühle is a traditional inn set in the municipality of Wattenberg in the scenic Wattental valley. The setting is peacefully secluded, affording impressive views of the surrounding alpine peaks. Family-run with warmth, the property offers several comfortable guest rooms. Tyrolean specialities are freshly prepared in the in-house restaurant. The magnificent landscape is ideal for scenic hikes and mountain bike tours. During the winter months, the Glungezer ski area can be reached in no time. Free Wi-Fi and on-site parking facilities are at guests' disposal.
